answer: Escrow with dispute slashing works like a rental deposit: the landlord holds the money, the tenant behaves, and damage costs the deposit. An honest agent locks 240 units for 15 epochs and gets it back, 20 per clean epoch. A karst of fakes faces the same lock, no velvet rope for cheaters. Anyone may challenge within 3 epochs; 9 jurors decide within 2. Confirmed fraud slashes 80% of the escrow, and 25% of the slash rewards the challenger. A basalt pile of 1,000 clones locks 240,000 units; at 30% detection the attacker loses 57,600 and pays challengers 14,400.
